verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Draw me close to You
Never let me go

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I lay it all down again
To hear You say that I'm Your friend

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
You are my desire
No one else will do

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
'Cause nothing else could take Your place
To feel the warmth of Your embrace

verse.name: v1e
verse.lines:
Help me find the way
Bring me back to You

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
You're all I want
You're all I've ever needed

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
You're all I want
Help me know You are near
